row.reference_answer: Before starting a part-time job you need a part-time work permit. row.question: Can you explain the group visa application process?
required_facts: Seoul: applying in person is the rule, but the OIA offers group visa (D-4->D-2 change, D-2 extension) and group residence-card applications

Seoul: from abroad, get the Certificate of Admission (overseas use), get the D-2 at the embassy, enter, then apply for the group residence card; in Korea, use the domestic-use certificate and the group visa (change mid-Aug, extension mid-Aug to mid-Sep)
ERICA: group registrations are announced in OIA notices each semester (guide as attachment); otherwise book on HiKorea and apply individually
row.reference_answer: Which campus are you at? At ERICA, group registrations are announced in the OIA notices each semester (the guide is an attachment the snapshot cannot read); otherwise book on HiKorea and apply at the immigration office yourself. At Seoul, applying in person is the rule, but the OIA runs group applications: if you are abroad, get the overseas-use Certificate of Admission, obtain the D-2 at the embassy, enter Korea and join the group residence-card application; if you are in Korea, use the domestic-use certificate and join the group visa application (change mid-August, extension mid-August to mid-September).
row.notes: Campus unstated (persona ERICA). ERICA's 2025 group visa guide is attachment-only (11.2), so the ERICA branch gives only the notice route.
